name: gin_pending_list_limit
description: Sets the maximum size (in kB) of the pending list used during GIN index insertions before entries are flushed to the main index structure.
symptoms: Slow GIN index creation or bulk inserts
High memory usage during concurrent GIN index writes
Increased WAL generation due to frequent pending list flushes
Index bloat from premature or excessive flushing
tuning_tips: Increase for large bulk GIN index builds to reduce flush frequency and improve throughput; decrease if memory pressure occurs or for OLTP workloads with many small GIN updates.
